stimulus: DailyStep — a free mobile habit-building app. Pick a habit, get a two-minute daily check-in, build a visible streak, and see friends' streaks in a shared leaderboard. Free with ads; an optional ad-free tier unlocks detailed stats and custom reminders.
custom_segment_description: US/EU health-conscious young professionals 22-40 building daily habits

outcome.label: hit
outcome.evidence: publicly-known freemium habit-streak app growth pattern: a low-friction daily check-in loop with visible streaks and light social accountability drove strong organic word-of-mouth growth and high day-over-day retention, with the free tier converting a meaningful minority to paid.

provenance.disguise_notes: no specific brand or company named; value prop (free daily streak habit tracker with light social accountability and an optional paid stats tier) and audience preserved from the publicly-known pattern
